_comment: Marquee's floor plan, and the ONLY hand-written list in the project.
It lists ROOTS, never works — what is inside each root is still derived
every run, so this file cannot drift the way a catalog can. Every root is
validated: if one vanishes, Marquee reports it instead of quietly shrinking.
THE BAR FOR ADDING A WING is deliberately high: a wing must be a curated
collection with its own CLAUDE.md catalog table, so premises exist and
drift is detectable. A folder that merely contains HTML does not qualify.
That rule is the only thing between this and a general-purpose file
browser, which would be worth less than a good front door to one
collection. If you are tempted to add a folder because it has some HTML
in it, the answer is no.
A RESIDENT is a single work that belongs to no collection, named here
because there is no catalog for it to be a row in. One at a time, on

residents.name: Shim
residents.premise: Something small and dark that lives in ~/.claude and accretes whatever it is given. Named Shim. It cannot be neglected.
